title: Cost to Serve Analyst - Global Service Operation
description:
Job Description:
**Cost to Serve Analyst**

**Role Purpose**


Join a high\-impact global transformation team driving Schneider Electric's Cost to Serve agenda across Service Operations. This role is ideal for an early\-career professional who is passionate about analytics, problem solving, and business performance. You will work closely with senior leaders and country teams to identify opportunities, build business cases, track results, and support transformation initiatives that deliver measurable operational and financial impact.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Analytics \& Insights**

* Analyze operational and financial data to identify productivity and cost optimization opportunities.
* Support the quantification of improvement initiatives and development of business cases.
* Create dashboards, reports, and performance insights to support decision\-making and benefit tracking.
* Translate complex data into clear and actionable recommendations.

**Transformation Support**

* Support the preparation and facilitation of Cost to Serve workshops.
* Consolidate, structure, and track opportunities identified during workshops.
* Help countries progress ideas from identification through validation and implementation.

**Governance \& Performance Tracking**

* Maintain governance routines, reporting, and benefit realization tracking.
* Monitor progress against targets and identify risks and improvement opportunities.
* Prepare executive\-level presentations and performance reviews.

**Best Practice \& Capability Building**

* Support the development of methodologies, playbooks, and best\-practice sharing across countries.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and knowledge management.


(External) English Qualifications:
**Qualifications \& Experience**

* 2–5 years of experience in analytics, consulting, finance, operations, or business performance roles.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to structure and interpret data.
* Good financial acumen and understanding of business performance drivers and P\&L concepts.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; experience with Power BI or other analytics tools is a strong advantage.
* Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex information.
* Exposure to Lean, continuous improvement, or operational excellence methodologies is a plus.
* Experience in Service Operations, Field Services, or industrial environments is advantageous but not required.
* Master's degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, Operations, Data Analytics, or a related field preferred.

 **What Makes You Successful**

* Curious and data\-driven with a passion for solving business problems.
* Strong learner who thrives in a fast\-paced, international environment.
* Comfortable working with senior stakeholders and cross\-functional teams.
* Demonstrates **Humility, Agility, and Mastery** in everything you do.
* Willingness to travel internationally and experience different markets and cultures.

**Why Join Us?**


This role offers a unique opportunity to gain exposure to senior leadership, work on global transformation programs, develop consulting\-style problem\-solving skills, and make a visible impact on operational and financial performance from day one.


Local Benefits (English):
**Rewards designed for you**


Our Total Rewards is our way of saying: We see you and we value you. It’s more than just pay and benefits—it’s a meaningful investment in you. It is designed to help you perform, grow, feel safe, and elevate your potential. The package helps you care for yourself and your family, plan your future, grow your skills and career, collaborate in an inclusive workplace, and contribute to your community. At Schneider Electric, we’re here for what matters most to you. Discover more at our Career Page.

* Country\-specific programs and initiatives may be available.


(External) English Company Boiler Plate: **Looking to make an IMPACT with your career?**


When you are thinking about joining a new team, culture matters. At Schneider Electric, our values and behaviors are the foundation for creating a great culture to support business success. We believe that our IMPACT values – Inclusion, Mastery, Purpose, Action, Curiosity, Teamwork – starts with us.


IMPACT is also your invitation to join Schneider Electric where you can contribute to turning sustainability ambition into actions, no matter what role you play. It is a call to connect your career with the ambition of achieving a more resilient, efficient, and sustainable world.


We are looking for IMPACT Makers; exceptional people who turn sustainability ambitions into actions at the intersection of automation, electrification, and digitization. We celebrate IMPACT Makers and believe everyone has the potential to be one.


Become an IMPACT Maker with Schneider Electric – apply today!

150 000\+ employees in 100\+ countries

  

You must submit an online application to be considered for any position with us. This position will be posted until filled. *Schneider Electric aspires to be the most inclusive and caring company in the world, by providing equitable opportunities to everyone, everywhere, and ensuring all employees feel uniquely valued and safe to contribute their best. We mirror the diversity of the communities in which we operate, and ‘inclusion’ is one of our core values. We believe our differences make us stronger as a company and as individuals and we are committed to championing inclusivity in everything we do.*

title: Accountant
description:
Job Description – Accounts Executive

**Company:** Tempt Smart Pvt. Ltd.  
**Location:** Delhi  
**Experience:** 2–5 Years  
**Qualification:** B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance

Key Responsibilities

* Handle day\-to\-day accounting entries in **Tally/ERP**.
* Manage sales, purchase, receipts, payments and journal entries.
* Handle **vendor and customer ledgers** and outstanding payments.
* Perform **bank and ledger reconciliation**.
* Manage employee expenses, reimbursements and advances.
* Assist in **GST, TDS, PF/ESIC** and other statutory compliance.
* Coordinate with CA/auditors for accounts and tax\-related work.
* Prepare monthly **MIS and outstanding reports**.
* Maintain proper bills, invoices and accounting records.

Required Skills

* Good knowledge of **Tally and MS Excel**.
* Basic knowledge of **GST \& TDS**.
* Good accounting and reconciliation skills.
* Good communication and attention to detail.

Pay: ₹20,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

title: Senior Accountant Executive
description:
* Complete **GST return filing** – GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B, reconciliation, ITC verification.
* **TDS calculation, payment and return filing**, including Form 26Q and reconciliation.
* Maintain **complete books of accounts** and ensure accurate accounting entries.
* Handle **inventory and stock accounting** – raw material, finished goods, consumables, wastage and stock reconciliation.
* Maintain **purchase, sales, debit/credit notes and vendor/customer ledgers**.
* Monitor **receivables, payables and outstanding balances**.
* Prepare **monthly MIS, expense reports, profitability reports and management reports**.
* Coordinate with **production/store/purchase teams** for stock and consumption data.
* Verify **purchase invoices, GST details, HSN/SAC and input tax credit**.
* Handle **bank reconciliation, cash transactions and payment entries**.
* Assist in **monthly closing, audit and statutory compliance**.
* Strong knowledge of **Tally/ERP and MS Excel** is required.
* Manufacturing/printing industry experience will be preferred.

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹40,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person
